title: Transferring funds to external banks: Bronze Accounts
summary: Explains transferring funds from Bronze Accounts to external banks: standard external transfers complete in 3 business days. It sets a $2,500 per day outgoing transfer limit and advises scheduling on non-business days to start processing the next business day, with status tracking (scheduled/in process/completed) and splitting transfers that exceed the limit.
faqs: How long do external transfers from Bronze Accounts take to complete?
